info.title: GIMME Voice API
info.description: Platform-neutral voice commerce API. Apple, Google and agent adapters call this; it maps onto the same service as the GIMME MCP tools. Amounts are decimal NZD. Every error body has error_code, message, recoverable and suggested_action.

oauth2.description: Tokens are issued by GIMME's authorization server (account linking). This API is a resource server only.

scopes.gimme.customer.read: Read your first name, saved address labels, payment method labels and order preferences
scopes.gimme.cart.create: Price a basket and prepare an order for your confirmation
scopes.gimme.order.create: Place an order you have confirmed
scopes.gimme.order.read: Read your order status and receipts
scopes.gimme.order.cancel: Cancel an order, where GIMME allows it
scopes.gimme.payment.authorize: Authorize payment for an order you have confirmed, using a saved payment method
scopes.gimme.order.confirm: Record your purchase confirmation (GIMME's own apps only)

post.description: Called by GIMME's own apps after the platform's native purchase confirmation. confirmed_total must equal the intent total exactly; device_authenticated must be true on platforms that require it.
